description: A single pump in Fairweather's grey, bolted through the decking at the head of the walkway: a cranked hose on a drum, a dead-man nozzle in a clip, a card reader with the paint worn off the keys, and a bonding cable coiled on a hook that everybody uses and nobody checks. The plate above the reader carries the rate for race fuel and nothing else — no grades, no offers, no hours, on the reasoning that anybody who has to ask is at the wrong marina.
name: the fuel pump
